audit_log.rationale: An address-specific ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) feasibility tool that generates comprehensive reports in minutes by analyzing parcel data, setbacks, lot-coverage limits, and zoning rules to determine if a homeowner can build a backyard home.

The core insight is that homeowners face a painful information asymmetry: they must spend thousands of dollars and weeks of time just to learn whether an ADU is feasible on their lot. ADU Ready collapses that discovery phase from weeks to minutes at 3% of the cost of an architect's feasibility opinion. The go-to-market strategy follows a deliberate manual-first approach: hand-aggregate zoning data for 3 high-volume cities where ADU regulations recently changed (maximizing intent-driven search traffic), generate the first 20 reports manually to validate the format and uncover the exact questions homeowners ask, then progressively automate the logic with Airtable and Zapier as patterns stabilize. The free Quick Check serves as a high-conversion lead magnet—homeowners who see a 'likely eligible' result have strong purchase intent for the full $149 report. The $349 premium tier captures higher willingness-to-pay from homeowners closer to a build decision while creating a feedback loop with ADU professionals. Revenue scales by expanding city-by-city, each new market unlocked by aggregating its zoning dataset. Long-term defensibility comes from accumulating proprietary zoning interpretation data, homeowner outcome data, and contractor network effects that no single competitor currently aggregates at the parcel level.
